description: This file defines a Logger utility class that mimics the Android Log class, providing static methods for logging at various levels such as VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, and ASSERT. It manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log processing and provides convenience methods to log messages and exceptions.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging messages at various levels, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log class and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which logs are sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (fatal error) message, optionally with an exception.
